methodology.sampler: cgroup v2, PID 1 RSS, one short awk Docker exec per second included in measured cgroup CPU and RAM
methodology.auth: per request, credentials in benchmark process memory only
methodology.fixtures: only previously created owned Contact and two Product UUIDs
methodology.phases: 10s idle cold, initialize/list, first schema, bounded read warmup, 5s idle warm, 30s each at concurrency 1/4/8, 5s idle after load
methodology.swap: disabled by memory-swap equal to memory
methodology.disk: Docker inspect unpacked image size; image cache, build tools, Docker engine and OS excluded
methodology.limits: bounds for this workload and native arm64 environment, not capacity guarantees
